chars.Y: YASSINE: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hooded puffer parka over a white t-shirt, dark blue jeans and white sneakers, a small black backpack.
chars.S: SOFIA: a young woman wearing a long burgundy wool coat over a cream turtleneck sweater, black trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE walks happily out of a busy French train station in the evening, carrying a small red gift box with a gold ribbon in his hand, smiling with excitement, rolling a small suitcase behind him.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE stands on a quiet French city street at night in front of an old stone apartment building with tall windows, looking up at a dark window, holding the red gift box, hopeful.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE climbs a narrow wooden staircase inside an old French apartment building, dim warm hallway light, holding the red gift box behind his back like a surprise.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE knocks on a closed wooden apartment door in a dim hallway, leaning his ear toward the door, confused because there is total silence; the doormat is empty.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE stands in the dim hallway next to the closed door looking down at his glowing smartphone (screen facing him, not visible), his face lit by the phone, eyebrows raised in disbelief.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Close shot of YASSINE in the dark hallway, shocked and hurt, mouth open, one hand on his head, the red gift box hanging low in his other hand.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE sits alone at a small table by the big window of a French bar-cafe at night, a cup of coffee in front of him and the red gift box on the table, staring across the street at the stone apartment building.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE at the cafe window table at night holding his smartphone (screen not visible), bitter sad expression, the coffee cup now empty, rain drops on the window.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: View from behind YASSINE's shoulder through the cafe window at night: across the empty wet street the lit entrance door of the stone apartment building under a streetlamp; YASSINE leans forward, tense, watching the door.
